title: Contradictory facts: automatic authority resolution (M14)
description: Mutually exclusive statements in one project, ingested WITHOUT declared supersessions and resolved by the automatic contradiction pass (explicit > decision > newer > confidence; a full tie marks both sides disputed). The dataset opts into the M14 consolidation pass; the offline harness runs contradiction resolution and decay, while the vector-gated passes (derivation, near-duplicate merge) skip with recorded warnings. Groups cover every authority level plus one full tie, and one cross-phrasing pair the template heuristic cannot detect (the documented detector gap).

contradictions.note: Cross-phrasing pair: both statements instantiate the same concept with different wording, so the attribute-template heuristic cannot detect it. The group documents the honest detector gap (M14 follow-up: LLM conflict detector) and stays in the gated metric at the measured value.
